title: MEIKO — Use A Rabbit As A Springboard?!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: Use A Rabbit As A Springboard?!（4★）

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, my costume's all ready and so is everything else for this show.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: All that's left is for me to stay focused and keep practicing. Hehe. I'm so excited!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO, hello!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Miku! Luka! Hi there♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're doing a moon viewing show, right? I can't wait to see it♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How's everything going for it? Do you need any help?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thanks, but I think I'm all set♪
It's ready to go off without a hitch.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really? It's so amazing how you're able to plan entire shows by yourself.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, it really is. I'm looking forward to seeing it very much♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I also remember seeing some Japanese-looking clothes lying around... Are you planning on wearing them during your show?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, aren't they gorgeous? They fit in with the show's theme so nicely too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Not only that, I'm hoping to do things a little differently during this show compared to normal.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Different how?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What are you going to do?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Why don't I just show you with a special sneak peek?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: My plan is to divide the entire show into three separate parts.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Three parts?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. Minori and the others explained to me how moon viewing celebrations evolved over the course of history.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's why I want the crowd to also experience how things change as time passes♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds so interesting.
What did you have in mind specifically?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: First, I'll start with a Heian period theme.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'll wear something that looks like a traditional twelve-layered kimono while playing music that features kotos and flutes♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, that would be quite different from what you usually do.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Right?
I was also thinking about working in some traditional Japanese dances into my routine.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: By dimming the spotlight, it could act as the moon that the nobles saw in ye olde times while the audience gets to celebrate it now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: My, what a wonderful idea♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What comes after that?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Part two will be more about how commoners integrated moon viewings into their fall harvest celebrations.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And part three would bring us back to the present. Here, we'll all sing and dance to some fun music, while looking up at the same moon♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's so cool! It's one big party from start to finish♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree. I had fun just listening to your explanation♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm essentially doing three different shows all at once this time, so my goal is to show everyone a different MEIKO during each part.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Part one in particular, the one about the Heian period, since I'll need to present myself with grace and serenity.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
A graceful and serene MEIKO...
You're going to look so beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree. Especially considering how you're usually so cute and full of energy during your shows.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Your audience might not know what to do with themselves after they see you in such a new light♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thanks, you two!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: However, I am somewhat concerned about how my fans will react when they see me present myself that way.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sort of wondering if I pushed the envelope a little too far with this show.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure they won't mind.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If I were one of your fans, I would love you no matter what you wear or how you look.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Like Luka said, they really might go even more head over heels for you after they see you do this!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're both right! This is the show I envisioned in my head. Something unique and spectacular.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'll be sure to follow through until the end and make it an instant classic!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Good luck, MEIKO.
I'll be cheering you on.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Me too♪
And feel free to ask us for help if you ever need it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you, I will!
The new MEIKO's going to put on a moon viewing show the likes of which have never been seen before♪
